items.title: Jimmy Wormworth interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 6, 2002
items.q: I guess by the time I was 16 I met Torrie and Ronnie Zito... Ronnie and I would lie on the floor in front of the phonograph and listen to all these records.

ctx.x: Played piano. Jimmy McIntyre, an alto saxophonist who I think ended up owning a music store somewhere near Richfield Springs or somewhere like that. Oh man — John Avolio, who I think became a music teacher and moved to Michigan, his father owned Avolio Electric near Proctor High School. The saxophonist was — gee I can’t remember his last name, good as I know him — he once came in the Five — he became a school teacher too and he became, well he came in the Five Spot once when I was working there, in 1959. He was…
The old fall back on thing.
